limits: Seven cases are finite headless simulation; viewed development seeds/repeats are not statistical or universal reliability
Original 100 ms cutoff and motion acceptance remain; a 97.41 ms observed maximum does not guarantee hard realtime under higher load
Native backend equivalence excludes warmup and wall deadlines; it is not a closed-loop proof
Timeout carry had zero actual activations in these final runs; fresh-model rejection and timeout path were verified by forced tests
Candidate combines native evaluation, checked carry, short-prefix retention and completion reserve; closed-loop gains cannot be assigned to one switch
Only original N10 constraints revalidated; short prefixes do not certify held-axis 8s tail
Solver IPOPT, absolute speed bounds, observer, timed leader and schema2 errors unchanged
No new two/five-robot, variable-speed obstacle, curve or physical validation in this stage
